## Technical reference

- [Main container address](../reference/ep7-1100.main-container.md): Where the main program sits in the update container.
- [Main program CPU base](../reference/ep7-1100.main-cpu-base.md): Runtime base of the decoded main program.
- [Never write to the logical flash range](../reference/hazard.logical-flash-writes.md): Addresses from 0x40000000 up are the logical flash range.
- [Never CPU-read an image buffer through its raw descriptor address](../reference/hazard.raw-image-buffer-read.md): Image buffers must be read through the bus window mapper, row by row.
- [Only call code in a section that has already loaded](../reference/hazard.section-load-order.md): Sections load one after another; a hook calling a later section can run before its target exists.
- [Keep patch state out of the loaded firmware image](../reference/hazard.state-in-loaded-image.md): Stores into the loaded program image have restarted cameras; stock firmware does not make them.
